title: sequenceDerivedScalarTower
statement:
Use the coefficient sequence module categories, chosen geometric and scalar comparisons, and bracketing interpretation of [def-trf-quotient-system-coherence-data]. The following component equation holds for the stipulated whole-system derived functors, with exactly the coefficient-field, scheme and invertibility hypotheses displayed in the Lean signature below. No boundedness, normalization, Tor-amplitude or coefficient-flatness assumption is added.

Lean statement:
theorem sequenceDerivedScalarTower
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E L : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L)
    (M : Type u) [Field M] [Algebra ℚ_[l] M] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] M]
    (j : L →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] M) {X Y : Scheme.{t}}
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ x : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField x)] (f : X ⟶ Y) :
    Functor.whiskerRight (integralComparisonSystemScalarPullback l E L ι f).hom
        (integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar l L M j X) ≫
      Functor.whiskerLeft (integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar l E L ι Y)
        (integralComparisonSystemScalarPullback l L M j f).hom ≫
      Functor.whiskerRight (integralComparisonSystemScalarComposition l E L M ι j Y).hom
        (integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l M f) =
    Functor.whiskerLeft (integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l E f)
        (integralComparisonSystemScalarComposition l E L M ι j X).hom ≫
      (integralComparisonSystemScalarPullback l E M (j.comp ι) f).hom

proof.text: Apply localization natural-transformation extensionality. For each cochain complex K choose a flat-term K-flat resolution P → K. Its image under Q is invertible. Naturality of both displayed pastings and cancellation of the image of this resolution reduce the equation to Q(P). This resolves the entire sequence-site module complex, without evaluation or inverse limits.

Use the existing sequencePullback_kflatgood computation in the integral comparison API to see that p(P) is K-flat. Transport the termwise tensor exactness of the resolution through siteSheafTensorRightIso to its IsFlatOnSite hypothesis. Scalar extension of P is K-flat by changeOfRings_isKFlat_independentCoefficients, without assuming flatness of the coefficient homomorphism.

Specialize the existing scalar-pullback normalization at P and at its first scalar extension, and the scalar-composition normalization at P and at p(P). Postcompose both sides with the composite of the third scalar counit and the exact geometric comparison. The scalar counit is invertible on P, so this postcomposition cancels. Naturality of the second scalar square, of the scalar associator, of the second scalar counit, and of the exact geometric comparison puts both composites into the same counit normal form.

The remaining equality is Q applied to the ordinary scalar-tower interchange cochain equation. Obtain the stalk-unit hypotheses of that equation by reflecting the given residue-field units through the local residue map. Apply sequenceScalarTower_interchange in each cochain degree, use homological-complex extensionality, and then apply functoriality of Q. This also covers identity coefficient homomorphisms and empty schemes.
